title: Sales summary by region and size band
purpose: Totals each region's net order value by size band for the weekly sales review, leaving the WEST region out, and lists the orders it left out.

outputs.grain: one row per region and size band

columns.name: REGION
columns.meaning: Sales region of the orders in the row

columns.name: SIZE_BAND
columns.meaning: Size band (LARGE, MEDIUM or SMALL) of the orders in the row

columns.name: TOTAL_NET
columns.meaning: Sum of NET, the discounted order value, for the region and band

columns.name: ORDERS
columns.meaning: Number of orders in the region and band

columns.name: PRICED_ORDERS
columns.meaning: Number of those orders that have a numeric AMOUNT

columns.name: LAST_ORDER
columns.meaning: Latest ORDER_DATE in the region and band

columns.name: ORDER_STATUS
columns.meaning: Order status (the source STATUS column, renamed)

columns.name: REGION
columns.meaning: Region of the order; NULL for an order that had none

columns.name: AMOUNT_TXT
columns.meaning: Order amount exactly as the source holds it, as text

steps.name: Read and clean orders
steps.does: Reads the ORDERS extract, cuts CUSTOMER to its first 10 characters and renames STATUS to ORDER_STATUS.

steps.name: Set the WEST region aside
steps.does: Splits the orders on REGION != "WEST": the True side carries on to the summary; the False side (WEST orders, and orders with no REGION) goes to the excluded list.

steps.name: Work out net value and size band
steps.does: Converts AMOUNT_TXT to a number (AMOUNT), applies a 10% discount on quantities of 10 or more and rounds to the cent (NET), and bands each order LARGE, MEDIUM or SMALL by AMOUNT (SIZE_BAND).

steps.name: Total by region and size band
steps.does: Sums NET, counts orders and priced orders and takes the latest order date for each region and size band, sorts the biggest totals first and writes SALES_SUMMARY.

steps.name: List the excluded orders
steps.does: Writes the orders that were set aside, with their cleaned columns, to EXCLUDED_ORDERS.

rules: Orders whose REGION is WEST are left out of SALES_SUMMARY and written to EXCLUDED_ORDERS instead.
An order with no REGION is not counted in the summary either: it is written to EXCLUDED_ORDERS with the WEST orders.
NET is AMOUNT times 0.9 when QTY is 10 or more, otherwise AMOUNT times 1, rounded to the cent.
SIZE_BAND is LARGE when AMOUNT is 1000 or more, MEDIUM when it is 100 or more and SMALL otherwise; an order whose AMOUNT_TXT is not a plain number has no AMOUNT and is SMALL.
CUSTOMER is cut to its first 10 characters, as Alteryx's String(10) does without complaint.
SALES_SUMMARY is sorted by TOTAL_NET, biggest first, then by REGION.

parity_risks.note: Filter [REGION] != "WEST": a NULL REGION makes the expression NULL, and Alteryx sends NULL to the False anchor, so tool 8's stream must keep those rows.
Round([AMOUNT] * IIF([QTY] >= 10, 0.9, 1), 0.01) is half away from zero on exact decimals; the arithmetic is done in NUMBER(38,10) and only the result is stored back as a Double.

ToNumber warns and nulls on text that is not a plain decimal (abc, 1,200.50, the empty string), and a NULL AMOUNT makes every comparison in the SIZE_BAND band NULL, so those rows fall to the ELSE branch SMALL.
Select retypes CUSTOMER to String(10): Alteryx truncates silently where Snowflake's VARCHAR(10) would raise, so the translation uses LEFT(CUSTOMER, 10).
Alteryx's Count counts rows where CountNonNull counts values: ORDERS is the number of rows in the group, PRICED_ORDERS only the rows with a non-NULL AMOUNT.
Sum over a Double column accumulates in binary floating point; the translation adds the exact decimal values and stores the total once, so TOTAL_NET agrees to the cent.
NULL placement differs between ascending and descending: Alteryx puts NULL first ascending and last descending, so the ORDER BY spells the NULLS placement out.
